expected_deltas.rationale: The catalog snapshot adds validation of the component-candidate evidence manifest. The exact old and new blob bindings are pinned to the two compared Git trees.
The catalog snapshot adds a component-candidate evidence manifest. Its candidates remain proposal/review evidence and do not establish canonical implementation ownership or VERIFIED status.
The catalog snapshot adds the schema for the component-candidate evidence manifest; the schema addition is paired with the added manifest.

limitations: This contract accounts only for the exact file deltas between the two pinned commits; it is not a merge approval.
Each expected delta is still checked against the source and catalog inventory blob bindings and the independently regenerated Git-tree manifests.
No semantic promotion of component candidates to CONFIRMED or VERIFIED is implied.
